blocks.content: In this step of your journey, you add the Infinity data source and give it a name.
To add the Infinity data source, complete the following steps:
In Grafana Cloud, open **Connections > Data sources**.
Open the data source catalog to choose a connection type.
From the search results, click the **Infinity** tile.
To rename the data source, click the pencil icon next to its name, enter a descriptive name, then click **Save**.
You added the Infinity data source and learned where to rename it. The name appears on dashboard panels and in data source pickers.
In the next step of your journey, you'll add basic authentication.
